vibe.verdict: The postmark now prints whole as ON THE RUN 2000 and the food and Hank lines are good, but the motel name still reads oddly and the front is sparse.
missing: Hank's 'no bitches after eleven' house rule
A thumb eaten by a fish
The triplets in the police helicopter
ideas: Swap the coffee milk note 'Charlie's home state, Rhode Island.' for the sons doing atomic mass homework at the counter
Swap the footer 'Prices subject to change.' for 'Rules when Charlie's away: no bitches after eleven.' (Hank)
Swap the clam chowder note for 'Well looky here, a human Q-tip.' and move Whitey to the house line
Give the front face a room-rules list or a Hank line so it isn't just the motel name and two posters
changed: Coffee milk is now 'The triplets' study-night coffee milk: Charlie's genius boys fear a B-plus.' (Shonte Jr.'s B-plus line)
Chowder line now 'Hank meets Whitey, a human Q-tip'
Poster art hidden from the front still and the postcard stamp: the front now shows Charlie and Irene, the stamp the motel bed with Irene's mugshot
changed2: Venue now 'The Motel Where They Left Whitey' (the motel has no name in the film), was 'Roadside Motel'
changed3: Venue shortened to 'Where They Left Whitey' so the stamp no longer cuts it
changed4: Sign now 'Out of Massena, on the run' so the motel postmark prints whole as 'ON THE RUN 2000' (it took the venue's first two words, 'WHERE THEY', when the sign had no short comma part); venue unchanged
